text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, I came across a drink in the 
vending machine called "Mystery Drink" 
where you can't tell what's inside...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It sounded interesting so I tried 
drinking it, but ever since, my body's 
been feeling weird...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It feels hot, yet cold, painful, yet 
suffocating... I don't really know what's 
going on~!

Special Week continued to feel somewhat 
under the weather for a while after 
that...
